description.value:
This simple, unpretentious pistol is the pride and joy of Arasaka engineers. Kenshin is one of the most cutting-edge – and deadliest – machine pistols available on the market. The Kenshin's brute power first comes from generating electromagnetic tension, before releasing a lethal, tungsten tipped round that can penetrate the sturdiest armor. Like other guns of this class, it comes ready-equipped with a holographic scope.

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Excellent Quality Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 20 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 2 rounds in a burst.

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
